FeaturesProcessor: Intel Celeron N4020 up to 2.8 GHzRAM Capacity: 4GBMemory Capacity: 64GB SSDGraphics: Intel UHD Graphics 605Front Camera: 2M pixelRear Camera: 8M pixelDimension (W x D x H): 26.3 x 16.9 x 1.2cmDisplay: 10.1" FHD (1920 x 1080) TouchscreenConnectivity: Bluetooth, WiFiOperating System: Windows 11 pro
Input/Output Ports1 x USB 3.2 Gen 11 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C (with DisplayPort and Power Delivery function)1 x Combo Audio (line-in / line-out)1 x RJ-45
Includes1 x FUJITSU Laptop STYLISTIC Q50101 x Charger

items: Efficient Processing Power - This Fujitsu laptop is equipped with an Intel Celeron N4020 processor and a solid state drive, which ensures smooth operation of Windows 11 Pro systems and professional applications, and easy processing of on-site data

Responsive Memory & Storage - The Stylistic Q5010 Tablet with 4GB RAM, enjoy smooth multitasking between your browser tabs and Android apps. 64GB of built-in eMMC storage provides ample space for your files, apps and downloads, ensuring you space for what matters most. 64GB SSD provides ample space for your files, apps and downloads, ensuring you space for what matters most

Rugged & durable - This mini laptop's thin and lightweight design with magnesium alloy casing and shock-resistant construction, and IP52 rating, makes it easy to work outdoors and on the move; and the digital touchscreen makes this notebook responsive even when wet or wearing gloves, for great operational flexibility

Port - USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C (with DisplayPort and Power Delivery function), Combo Audio, RJ-45; Enables desktop-level connectivity with the ability to switch office modes with a single click

Windows 11 Pro - The Fujitsu Tablet Stylistic Q5010 Windows tablet pc pre-installed with Windows 11 Professional to ensure device and data security, suitable for enterprise-level batch deployment and management
